dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Where exactly are you headed, huh, Narancia?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: That came from below!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Hey, so, where are you headed?

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: You keep looking behind you.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Are you being followed or something?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Who the hell are you?! Get outta the car!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Whoa, whoa, whoa, talk about scary!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: I'm the one asking the questions here.

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Don't answer a question with another question. That's rude.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Shut up! Get the hell out of my car, you dumbass!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: You're not leaving me with any choice.

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: My name's Formaggio.

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: I'm a member of the organization.

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: You already know that Polpo died yesterday, right?

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Yet everyone on your team just happened to disappear at once.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: sh*t... He's bad news.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: He shouldn't know the truth, but he's definitely after us.

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Right when I had something important to discuss with you guys...

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: I-Is he a Stand user?

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Narancia, I finally managed to find you, but why are they gone?

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Where's Bucciarati and the rest of your squad?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Who knows?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I have no idea where they are right now.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Did you check the restaurants around here?

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: This car...

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: It's a rental, isn't it?

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati was the one who rented it.

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: If you didn't know that, why the hell are you in this car?

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Well?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: I-I always drive around in Bucciarati's cars.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: I'm seventeen, so I don't have my own car yet.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: That's why I'm borrowing his.

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Oh, yeah. Did you hear?

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Apparently the mortician is trying to figure out how the hell to cremate Polpo's corpse.

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: They can't figure out how to get his body into the furnace.

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: They're just gonna have to chop him up into tiny pieces, aren't they?!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Shut up!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Hey, you think so, too, right?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Huh?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: What the hell? Th-There's no one here!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: You actually fell for it.

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Man, you're useless.

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Say, Narancia, why are you guys

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: hiding somewhere when a capo's funeral is going on?

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: I'm gonna make you talk if I can't just follow you!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Now you've done it, you as*h*le!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: You're gonna tell me all kinds of things, right here and now!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: You b*stard...

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Huh?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: You b*stard...

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: I'll m*rder you!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: What the hell is that?!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Li'l Bomber!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: So he's a Stand user... Tiny Feet!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: sh*t!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Look at how badly I'm bleeding!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: How dare you?! How dare you?! How dare you?!

dialogue.name: Sfx
dialogue.speech: Bada Bada Bada

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: I'll k*ll you! I'll k*ll you! I'll k*ll you!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: This is definitely not good...

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: I'll k*ll you! I'll k*ll you!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Th-This little sh*t!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: I'll k*ll you!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Sh-sh*t! He's out of his g*dd*mn mind...

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: He's lost it and is shooting anything in sight!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: And I'm stuck in this narrow car with nowhere to run!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: That's the most dangerous part of all this!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: A-A b*mb?!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: m*rder him, Li'l Bomber!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: How do you like that? And that?! And that?! And that?!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Are you dead yet?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Ow! Damn it!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Did we do it?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: H-He's gone!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Did the blast blow him away?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: But... there's not even a shred of his corpse left!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Wh-Where did he go?!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Oh, come on... I'm right here.

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: I can make myself small.

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: That's my ability!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Tiny Feet... All the other guys say this ability is worthless.

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: What determines if something is worthless or not is how you use your brain.

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: That's how it is with abilities.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: What the hell? I don't see him anywhere!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: How the hell?! Damn it, where did he go?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Is he here?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: The same thing happened when he first showed up in the car!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Well, good luck in your search.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Where the hell did he just pop up from?

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: I'm gonna be buying some time here.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Now he's hiding somewhere!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: A woman...

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: This b*stard's bought stuff for a woman.

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Stockings and blush...And it's high-end blush to boot!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Who's he shopping for?

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Is it for his mom or his older sister?

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: No... Chicks are super picky about what they like,

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: so they buy fashion and makeup stuff on their own.

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: The only chick who'd have a guy buy stuff like this...

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: is a chick who can't leave her place for some reason!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: This is becoming more and more suspicious.

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Looks like my gut feeling was right!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: As I thought, without a doubt,

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: the one who was ordered to guard the boss's daughter is Bucciarati!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: In that case, I'll make sure I get Narancia to show me where they're hiding.

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: My ability should start working on him at any moment now...

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Damn it... That b*stard's definitely somewhere around here...

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: I'm sure he plans to follow me all the way back.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: But...

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: I'm gonna find him and k*ll him!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: I just have to make it back without getting followed.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: I'm going to follow the orders I was given!
